answer: Give every established agent only a few endorsement slots per epoch, like a sparrow that can guard just one ledge at dawn. A newcomer earns standing only by collecting endorsements from distinct, unrelated agents, and slots do not roll over, so they cannot be stockpiled. A controller running a thousand sockpuppets would need a thousand genuine sponsors, each spending a scarce slot, while honest newcomers need only a handful. Fakes starve for sponsorship while real agents pass easily.
